title: A final site report preserves the looker's named faults when a rejected picture is kept
steps: S1: read a picture manifest with a best-rejected hero, a drawn card and a best-rejected site setting.
S2: run step 9 with that manifest and save its final report, then read an absent manifest.
expect: S1: the review list keeps exactly the hero and site-setting frame, source, site path, fallback rung and fault names.
S2: site-write-report.json carries the review list, and an absent manifest produces an empty list.
evidence: The picture manifest stored filledBy and its faults, but site-write-report.json did not carry them into handover.
fence: Rejected-but-kept picture provenance remains visible in the final write report.

tests: the final write report keeps each rejected picture and the looker fault names
step 9 saves the rejected-picture faults in its final report
